The Lord rules supreme in heaven,
greater than the roar of the ocean,
more powerful than the waves of the sea.
Your laws are eternal, Lord,
and your temple is holy indeed,
forever and ever.

items.label: Advent
items.text: Every mountain and hill shall be laid low, the rugged places shall be made smooth and the mountain-ranges become a plain. Come, Lord, and do not delay, alleluia.

items.label: Lent
items.text: Springs of water, bless the Lord: give glory and eternal praise to him.

items.label: Eastertide
items.text: The whole creation will be freed and will enjoy the glory and freedom of the children of God, alleluia.

items.label: Through the Year
items.text: May you be praised, Lord, and extolled for ever, alleluia.

strophes.t: All you, works of the Lord, bless the Lord.
And you, angels of the Lord, bless the Lord.
And you, the heavens of the Lord, bless the Lord.
And you, clouds of the sky, bless the Lord.
And you, all powers of the Lord, bless the Lord.
And you, sun and moon, bless the Lord.
And you, the stars of the heavens, bless the Lord.
And you, rains and dews, bless the Lord.
And you, all breezes and winds, bless the Lord.
And you, fire and heat, bless the Lord.
And you, frosts and cold, bless the Lord.
And you, frost and snow, bless the Lord.
And you, night and day, bless the Lord.
And you, darkness and light, bless the Lord.
And you, lightning and clouds, bless the Lord.
O let the earth, bless the Lord.
And you, mountains and hills, bless the Lord.
And you, all plants of the earth, bless the Lord.
And you, fountains and springs, bless the Lord.
And you, rivers and seas, bless the Lord.
And you, creatures of the sea, bless the Lord.
And you, every bird in the sky, bless the Lord.
And you, wild beasts and tame, bless the Lord.
And you, children of men, bless the Lord.
O Israel, bless the Lord, O bless the Lord.
And you, priests of the Lord, bless the Lord.
And you, servants of the Lord, bless the Lord.
And you, spirits and souls of the just, bless the Lord.
And you, holy and humble of heart, bless the Lord.
Ananiah, Azariah, Mishael, bless the Lord.
May you be blessed, O Lord, in the heavens.
To you be highest glory and praise forever.

blocks.note: Optional response after each line: “To him be highest glory and praise forever.”

items.label: Advent
items.text: I will give salvation to Sion, I will bring my glory to Jerusalem, alleluia.

items.label: Lent
items.text: All kings and peoples of the earth, praise God.

items.label: Eastertide
items.text: The name of the Lord is praised, in heaven and on earth, alleluia.

items.label: Through the Year
items.text: Praise the Lord from the heavens, alleluia.

blocks.title: A Call for the Universe to Praise God

strophes.t: Praise the Lord!
Praise the Lord from heaven,
you that live in the heights above!
Praise him, all his angels,
all his heavenly armies!
Praise him, sun and moon;
praise him, shining stars!
Praise him, highest heavens,
and the waters above the sky!
Let them all praise the name of the Lord!
He commanded, and they were created;
by his command they were fixed in their places forever,
and they cannot disobey.
Praise the Lord from the earth,
sea monsters and all ocean depths;
lightning and hail, snow and clouds,
strong winds that obey his command!
Praise him, hills and mountains,
fruit trees and forest;
all animals, tame and wild,
reptiles and birds!
Praise him, kings and all peoples,
princes and all other rulers;
young men and girls,
old people and children also!
Let them all praise the name of the Lord.
His name is greater than all others;
his glory is above earth and heaven!
He made his nation strong,
so that all his people praise him,
the people of Israel, so dear to him!
Praise the Lord!

paras.t: Antiphons for Advent, Christmastide, Lent & Eastertide, see Pg 14

items.label: Through the Year
items.text: I called to the Lord in my distress, and he heard me, alleluia.

blocks.title: A Prayer of Thanks for Victory

strophes.t: Give thanks to the Lord because he is good
and his love is eternal
Let the people of Israel say
“His love is eternal.”
Let the priests of God say,
“His love is eternal.”
Let all who fear him say,
“His love is eternal.”
In my distress I called to the Lord;
He answered me, and set me free.
The Lord is with me, I will not be afraid;
what can men do to me?
It is the Lord who helps me,
and I will see my enemies defeated.
It is better to trust in the Lord,
than to depend on men.
It is better to trust in the Lord,
than to depend on human leaders.

items.label: Through the Year
items.text: The Lord's right hand has raised me up, alleluia.

blocks.title: A Prayer of Thanks for Victory

strophes.t: Many enemies were around me;
but I destroyed them by the power of the Lord !
They were around me on every side;
but I destroyed them by the power of the Lord !
They swarmed around me like bees,
but they burned out as quickly as a brush fire;
by the power of the Lord I destroyed them .
I was fiercely attacked and was being defeated,
but the Lord helped me.
The Lord makes me powerful and strong;
he is my Saviour?
Listen to the glad shouts of victory in the tents of God's people;
“The Lord’s mighty power has done it!
His power has brought us victory,
his mighty power in battle!”
I will not die, but I will live,
and tell what the Lord has done.
He has punished me severely,
but he has not let me die.

items.label: Through the Year
items.text: The Lord God is our light, alleluia.

blocks.title: A Prayer of Thanks for Victory

strophes.t: Open the gates of the temple for me;
I will go in and praise the Lord!
This is the gate of the Lord;
only the righteous can come in!
I praise, you Lord, because you heard me,
because you have given me victory!
The stone which the builders rejected as worthless,
turned out to be the most important of all.
This was done by the Lord;
what a wonderful sight it is!
What a wonderful day the Lord has given us;
let us be happy, let us celebrate!
Save us, Lord, save us!
Give us success, Lord!
God bless him who comes in the name of the Lord !
From the temple of the Lord we bless you!
The Lord is God; he has been good to us.
With branches in your hands start the festival
and march around the altar.
You are my God and I give you thanks;
I will proclaim your greatness.
Give thanks to the Lord, because he is good,
and his love is eternal.

items.label: Advent
items.text: See, the Lord will come. He will sit with princes and he will mount the glorious throne.

items.label: Lent
items.text: Lord, almighty king, deliver us for the sake of your name. Give us the grace to return to you.

items.label: Eastertide
items.text: When he had made purification for sin, he sat at the right hand of the Majesty on high, alleluia.

items.label: Through the Year
items.text: The Lord's revelation to my Master: `Sit on my right', alleluia.

blocks.title: The Lord and His Chosen King

strophes.t: The Lord said to my Lord, the king,
“Sit here at my right side,
until I put your enemies under your feet.”
From Zion the Lord will extend your royal power.
“Rule over your enemies,” he says.
The day you fight your enemies
your people will volunteer.
Like the dew early in the morning,
your young men will come to you on the sacred hills.
The Lord made a solemn promise and will not take it back:
“You will be a priest forever,
in the priestly order of Melchizedek.”
The Lord is at your right side;
he will defeat kings on the day he becomes angry.
The king will drink from the stream by the road,
and strengthened, he will stand victorious.

items.label: Advent
items.text: The mountains will bring forth joy and the hills justice; for the Lord, the light of the world, comes in strength.

items.label: Lent
items.text: We were ransomed with the precious blood of Christ, the Lamb who is without blemish.

items.label: Eastertide
items.text: The Lord has delivered his people, alleluia.

items.label: Through the Year
items.text: The Lord is full of merciful love; he makes us remember his wonders, alleluia.

strophes.t: With all my heart I will thank the Lord,
in the meeting of his people.
How wonderful are the things the Lord does!
All who are pleased with them want to understand them.
All he does is full of honour and majesty;
his righteousness is eternal.
The Lord does not let us forget his wonderful actions;
he is kind and merciful.
He provides food for those who fear him;
he never forgets his covenant.
He has shown his power to his people,
by giving them the lands of foreigners.
In all he does he is faithful and just;
all his commandments are dependable.
They last for all time;
They were given in truth and righteousness.
He brought salvation to his people,
and made an eternal covenant with them.
Holy and mighty is he!
The way to become wise is to fear the Lord;
he gives sound judgment to all who obey his commands.
He is to be praised forever!

items.label: Advent
items.text: Let us live justly and honestly while we are awaiting, in hope, the coming of the Lord.

items.label: Eastertide
items.text: Alleluia, the Lord our God is king; let us rejoice and give glory to him, alleluia.

items.label: Through the Year
items.text: The Lord our God Almighty is king, alleluia.

strophes.t: Halleluia! Salvation, glory, and power belong to our God!
Halleluia!
True and righteous are his judgements! Halleluia, halleuia!
Halleluia ! Praise our God, all his servants, Halleluia!
and all men, both great and small, who fear him!
Halleluia, halleluia!
Halleluia! For the Lord, our Almighty God, is King! Halleluia!
Let us rejoice and be glad; let us praise his greatness!
Halleluia, halleluia!
Halleluia! For the time has come for the wedding of the Lamb.
Halleluia !
and his bride has prepared herself for it. Halleluia, halleluia!
Halleluia ! She has been permitted to dress herself. Halleluia!
with clean shining linen. Halleluia, halleluia!

items.label: Outside Easter
items.text: They are happy, who dwell in your house, Lord.

items.label: 17-23 December
items.text: Behold, the Lord, the ruler of the kings of the earth, will come. Happy are those who are ready to meet him.

items.label: Eastertide
items.text: My heart and my soul ring out their joy to the living God, alleluia.

strophes.t: How I love your temple, Almighty God !
How I want to be there !
I long for the courts of the Lord’s temple.
With my whole being I sing with joy to the living God.
Even the sparrows have built a nest,
and the swallows have their own home;
they keep their young near your altars,
Lord Almighty, my king and my God.
How happy are those who live in your temple,
always singing praise to you !
How happy are those whose strength comes from you,
who are eager to make the pilgrimage to Mount Zion.
As they pass through the dry valley
it becomes a place of springs;
the early rain fills it with pools.
They grow stronger as they go;
they will see the God of gods on Zion!
Hear my prayer, Lord God Almighty;
listen, God of Jacob!
Bless our king, God,
the king you have chosen!
One day spent in your temple
is better than a thousand anywhere else;
I would rather stand at the gate of the house of my God,
than live in the homes of the wicked.
The Lord is our protector and glorious king,
blessing us with kindness and honour.
He does not refuse any good thing
to those who do what is right.
Happy are those who trust in you,
Almighty God!

items.label: Outside Easter
items.text: Come, let us go up to the mountain of the Lord.

items.label: 17-23 December
items.text: Sing a new song to the Lord: Praise him throughout the world.

items.label: Eastertide
items.text: Great is the Temple of the Lord; all the nations will go there to worship, alleluia.

strophes.t: In days to come, the Lord’s temple hill
shall tower above the mountains
and be raised above the hills.
All the nations will come crowding to it.
Many peoples shall come and say:
Let us go up the mountain of the Lord
to the house of the God of Jacob,
that he may teach us his ways,
and we may walk in his paths.
For instruction shall go forth from Zion,
and the word of the Lord from Jerusalem.
He shall judge between the nations,
and impose terms on many peoples.
They shall beat their swords into hoes,
and their spears into harvest tools.
Nation shall not raise the sword against nation,
nor shall they train for war again.
O house of Jacob, come,
let us walk in the light of the Lord.

items.label: Outside Easter
items.text: O sing to the Lord, bless his name.

items.label: 17-23 December
items.text: When the Son of Man comes, will he find any faith on earth?

items.label: Eastertide
items.text: Proclaim to the nations: `God is king', alleluia.

strophes.t: Sing a new song to the Lord!
Sing to the Lord, all the world!
Sing to the Lord, and praise him!
Every day tell the good news that he has saved us!
Proclaim his glory to the nations,
his mighty acts to all peoples.
The Lord is great, and must be highly praised;
he must be feared more man all the gods.
The gods of all other nations are only idols,
but the Lord made the heavens.
Glory and majesty are around him,
greatness and beauty are in his temple.
All people on earth, praise the Lord.
Praise his glory and might!
Praise the Lord’s glorious name;
bring an offering and come into his temple.
Bow down before the Holy One when he appears;
tremble before him, all the earth!
Say to all the nations, “The Lord is king!
The earth is set firmly in place and cannot be moved;
he will judge all peoples with justice.”
Be glad, earth and sky!
Roar, sea, and all the creatures in you;
be glad, fields, and everything in you!
Then the trees in the woods will shout for joy before the Lord,
because he comes to rule the earth.
He will rule all peoples of the world
with justice and fairness.

paras.t: Antiphons for Advent, Christmastide, Lent & Eastertide, see Pg 14

items.label: Through the Year
items.text: I seek your precepts, Lord, for with them you give me life.

blocks.title: Faith in the Law of the Lord

strophes.t: Your word, Lord, will last forever;
it is firm in heaven.
Your faithfulness endures through all the ages;
you have set the earth in place and it remains.
All things remain to this day because of your command,
because they are all your servants.
If your law had not been the source of my joy,
I would have died from my punishment.
I will never neglect your rules,
because by them you have kept me alive.
I am yours -- save me!
I have tried to obey your commands.
Wicked men are waiting to kill me,
but I will meditate on your laws.
I have learned that nothing is perfect;
but your commandment has no limits.

items.label: Through the Year
items.text: O Lord, you have been my hope since my youth.

strophes.t: Lord, I am safe with you;
never let me be defeated!
Because you are righteous, help me and rescue me.
Listen to me and save me?
Be my secure shelter,
and a strong fortress to protect me;
you are my refuge and defense.
My God, rescue me from wicked men,
from the power of cruel and evil men
Lord, I put my hope in you;
I have trusted in you since I was young.
I have relied on you all my life;
you have protected me since I was born;
I will always praise you!
My life has been a mystery to many,
but you are my strong defender.
All day long, I praise you
and proclaim your glory.
Do not reject me now that I am old;
do not abandon me now that I am feeble!
My enemies want to kill me;
they talk and plot against me.
They say, “God has abandoned him;
let us go after him and catch him,
because there is no one to rescue him!”
Don't stay so far away, God;
my God, help me now!
May those who attack me
be defeated and destroyed!
May those who try to hurt me
be shamed and disgraced!

items.label: Through the Year
items.text: When I grow old, do not forsake me, O God.

strophes.t: I will always put my hope in you;
I will praise you more and more.
I will tell of your righteousness:
all day long I will speak of your salvation,
though it is more than I can understand.
I will praise your power, Lord God;
I will proclaim your righteousness; yours alone.
You have taught me ever since I was young,
and I still tell of your wonderful acts.
Now that I am old and my hair is gray,
do not abandon me, God!
Be with me while I proclaim your power and might
to all generations to come.
Your righteousness, God, reaches the skies.
You have done great things;
there is no one like you!
You have sent troubles and suffering on me,
but you will restore my strength;
you will keep me from the grave.
You will make me greater than ever;
you will comfort me again.
I will indeed praise you with the harp;
I will praise your faithfulness, my God.
On my harp I will play hymns to you,
the Holy One of Israel.
I will shout for joy as I play for you;
with my whole being I will sing,
because you have saved me.
I will speak of your righteousness all day long,
because those who tried to harm me
have been defeated and disgraced.

items.label: Outside Easter
items.text: Our eyes are turned to the Lord; we look for his mercy.

items.label: 17-23 December
items.text: Behold, the Lord, the ruler of the kings of the earth, will come. Happy are those who are ready to meet him.

items.label: Eastertide
items.text: The Lord will be your everlasting light, your God will be your glory, alleluia.

strophes.t: Lord, I look up to you,
up to heaven, where you rule.
As the servant depends on his master,
and the maid depends on her mistress,
so we keep looking to you, Lord our God,
until you have mercy on us.
Be merciful to us, Lord, be merciful;
we have been treated with so much contempt!
We have been mocked too long by the rich,
and scorned by proud oppressors!

items.label: Outside Easter
items.text: Our help is in the name of the Lord, who made heaven and earth.

items.label: 17-23 December
items.text: Sing a new song to the Lord: Praise him throughout the world.

items.label: Eastertide
items.text: The snare has been broken and we have escaped, alleluia.

blocks.title: God the Saviour of His People

strophes.t: What if the Lord had not been on our side.
Answer, Israel!
“If the Lord had not been on our side,
when our enemies attacked us,
then they would have swallowed us alive,
in their furious anger against us;
then the flood would have carried us away,
the water would have drowned us,
the raging torrent would have drowned us.”
Let us thank the Lord,
who has not let our enemies destroy us.
We have escaped like a bird from the hunter’s trap;
the trap has been broken, and we are free!
Our help comes from the Lord,
who made heaven and earth.

items.label: Outside Easter
items.text: God has chosen us to be his adopted children through his Son.

items.label: 17-23 December
items.text: When the Son of Man comes, will he find any faith on earth?

items.label: Eastertide
items.text: When I am lifted up from the earth, I shall draw all men to myself, alleluia.

strophes.t: Let us give thanks to the God and Father
of our Lord Jesus Christ!
For he has blessed us,
in our union with Christ,
by giving us every spiritual gift
in the heavenly world.
Before the world was made,
God had already chosen us
to be his in Christ
so that we would be holy and without fault before him.
Because of his love,
God had already decided
that through Jesus Christ
he would bring us to himself as his sons;
this was his pleasure and purpose.
Let us praise God for his glorious grace,
for the free gift he gave us in his dear Son!
For by the death of Christ we are set free,
and our sins are forgiven.
How great is the grace of God,
which he gave to us in such large measure!
In all his wisdom and insight
God did what he had purposed,
and made known to us the secret plan
he had already decided to complete
by means of Christ.
God's plan which he will complete
when the time is right,
is to bring all creation together,
everything in heaven and on earth,
with Christ as head.

items.label: Outside Easter
items.text: Lord, you blessed your land; you forgave the guilt of your people.

items.label: 17-23 December
items.text: The Lord will come from his holy place: he will come to save his people.

items.label: Eastertide
items.text: You will restore our life again, Lord, and your people will rejoice in you, alleluia.

blocks.title: A Prayer for the Nation’s Welfare

strophes.t: Lord, you have been kind to your land;
you made Israel prosperous again.
You have forgiven your people’s sins
and pardoned all their wrongs.
You stopped being angry with them
and put away your furious rage.
Bring us back, God our Saviour,
and stop being displeased with us!
Will you be angry with us forever?
Will your anger never cease?
Please renew our strength,
and we, your people, will praise you.
Show us your constant love, Lord,
and give us your saving help.
I am listening to what the Lord God is saying;
he promises peace to us, his own people,
if we do not go back to our foolish ways.
Surely he is ready to save those who honour him,
and his saving presence will remain in our land.
Love and faithfulness will come together;
righteousness and peace will meet.
Man’s loyalty will reach up from the earth,
and God’s righteousness will look down from heaven.
The Lord will make us prosperous,
and our land will produce rich harvest.
Righteousness will go before the Lord,
and prepare the path for him.

items.label: Outside Easter
items.text: At night, my soul longs for you; I watch for you at daybreak.

items.label: 17-23 December
items.text: We have a strong city, Sion. The Saviour will set up wall and rampart to guard it. Open the gates, for God is with us, alleluia.

items.label: Eastertide
items.text: We put our trust in the Lord and he gave us peace, alleluia.

strophes.t: The city we have is strong;
its walls and ramparts protect us.
Open its gates, let its people in,
an honest and faithful nation.
Their mind is firm; you keep them prosperous,
because they trust in you.
Trust in the Lord forever!
for the Lord is an everlasting Rock.
The path of the honest man is straight;
you make his way level and smooth.
Following the ways you determine,
Lord, we trust in you.
I long for you and want to keep you in mind;
my heart longs for you in the night;
my spirit within me seeks you.
Your decisions are a light to the world,
that everyone may learn to act rightly.
Lord, you have made us prosper,
for all our works are your doing.

items.label: Outside Easter
items.text: Lord, let your face shed its light upon us.

items.label: 17-23 December
items.text: Let us know your way on earth, Lord: let all the peoples know your saving power.

items.label: Eastertide
items.text: The earth has yielded its fruit; let the nations be glad and exult, alleluia.

strophes.t: God be merciful to us and bless us;
look on us with kindness,
that the whole world may know your will;
that all nations may know your salvation.
May the peoples praise you, God;
may all peoples praise you !
May the nations be glad and sing for joy,
because you judge the peoples with justice
and guide all the nations.
May the peoples praise you, God;
may all peoples praise you!
The land has produced its harvest;
God, our God, has blessed us.
God has blessed us;
may all people everywhere honour him.

paras.t: Antiphons for Advent, Christmastide, Lent & Eastertide, see Pg 14

items.label: Through the Year
items.text: Love is the fullness of the Law.

blocks.title: Love for the Law of the Lord

strophes.t: How I love your law!
I think about it all day long.
Your commandment is with me all the time,
and makes me wiser than all my enemies.
I understand more than all my teachers,
because I think on your instructions.
I have greater wisdom than old men,
because I obey your commands.
I have avoided all evil conduct,
because I want to obey your word.
I have not neglected your instructions,
because it was you who taught me.
How sweet is the taste of your rules;
they are sweeter than honey!
I gain wisdom from your laws,
and so I hate all bad conduct.

items.label: Through the Year
items.text: Remember your people, Lord, whom you chose long ago.

strophes.t: Why have you abandoned us like this, God?
Will you be angry with your own people forever?
Remember your people, whom you chose to be yours
a long time ago,
the people you redeemed to be your own tribe.
Remember Mount Zion, where you have lived!
Come and walk over these total ruins;
our enemies have destroyed everything in the temple!
Your enemies shout in triumph in your meeting place;
they have taken over the temple.
They looked like woodsmen
cutting down trees with their axes.
They smashed all the wooden panels
with their axes and battering rams.
They set your temple on fire,
they profaned the place where you are worshipped;
they wrecked it all.
They decided to crush us completely ;
They burned down every holy place in the land.
All our sacred symbols are gone;
there are no prophets left,
and no one knows how long this will last.
How long, God, will our enemies make fun of us?
will they insult your name forever?
Why have you refused to help us?
Why do you keep your hands behind you?

items.label: Through the Year
items.text: Arise, O Lord, and defend your cause.

strophes.t: But God, you have been our king from the beginning;
you win victories on earth.
With your mighty strength you divided the sea
and smashed the heads of the sea monsters;
you crushed the heads of the monster Leviathan,
and gave the desert people his dead body to eat.
You made springs and fountains flow;
you dried up large rivers.
You created the day and the night,
you set the sun and the moon in their places;
you set the limits of the earth;
you made summer and winter.
But remember, Lord, that your enemies make fun of you;
that they are foolish and despise you.
Don't abandon your helpless people to their cruel enemies;
don't forget your persecuted people!
Remember the covenant you made with us.
There is violence in every dark corner of the land!
Don't let the oppressed be defeated,
but let the poor and needy praise you.
Rise, God, and defend your cause!
Remember that the godless make fun of you all day long!
Don't forget the angry shouts of your enemies,
the continuous noise made by your foes.

items.label: Outside Easter
items.text: The Lord surrounds his people.

items.label: 17-23 December
items.text: The Lord will come from his holy place: he will come to save his people.

items.label: Eastertide
items.text: Peace be with you, it is I; do not be afraid, alleluia.

strophes.t: Those who trust in the Lord are like Mount Zion,
which can never be shaken, never be moved,
As the mountains surround Jerusalem,
so the Lord surrounds his people,
from now on and forever.
The wicked will not always rule over the land of God's people;
if they did, God’s people themselves might do evil.
Lord do good to those who are good,
to those obey your commands!
But punish those who follow their own wicked ways,
when you punish the evildoers!
Peace be with Israel!

items.label: Outside Easter
items.text: Unless you become like little children, you will not enter the kingdom of heaven.

items.label: 17-23 December
items.text: We have a strong city, Sion. The Saviour will set up wall and rampart to guard it. Open the gates, for God is with us, alleluia.

items.label: Eastertide
items.text: O Israel, hope in the Lord, alleluia.

strophes.t: Lord I have given up my pride,
and turned from my arrogance.
I am not concerned with great matters,
or with subjects too difficult for me.
But I am content and at peace.
As a child lies quietly in its mother’s arms,
so my heart is quiet within me.
Israel, trust in the Lord,
from now on and forever!

items.label: Outside Easter
items.text: Lord, you made us a kingdom and priests to serve our God.

items.label: 17-23 December
items.text: Let us know your way on earth, Lord: let all the peoples know your saving power.

items.label: Eastertide
items.text: May your whole creation serve you; for you spoke and they came into being, alleluia.

strophes.t: Our Lord and God! You are worthy
to receive glory, and honour, and power.
For you created all things
and by your will they were given existence and life.
Lamb of God, you are worthy to take the scroll,
and to break open its seals.
For you were killed,
and by your death you bought men for God,
from every tribe, and language, and people, and nation.
You have made them a kingdom of priests to serve our God;
and they shall rule on earth.
The Lamb who was killed is worthy
to receive power, wealth, wisdom and strength,
honour, glory, and praise.

items.label: Outside Easter
items.text: Give joy to your servant, Lord, for to you I lift up my soul.

items.label: 17-23 December
items.text: The Lord who is all-powerful will come from Sion to save his people.

items.label: Eastertide
items.text: All the nations shall come to adore you, O Lord, alleluia.

strophes.t: Listen to me, Lord, and answer me,
because I am weak and helpless.
Save me from death, because I am loyal to you;
save me, because I am your servant and trust in you.
You are my God, so be merciful to me, Lord;
I pray to you all day long.
Make your servant glad, Lord,
because my prayers go up to you.
Lord, you are good and forgiving,
full of constant love for all who pray to you.
Listen, Lord, to my prayer;
hear my cries for help.
I call to you in times of trouble,
because you answer my prayer.
There is no other god like you, Lord,
not one who can do what you can do.
All the nations you have created
will come and bow down to you.
They will praise your greatness,
because only you, God, are mighty;
only you do wonderful things.
Teach me, Lord, what you want me to do,
and I will obey you faithfully;
teach me to serve you with complete devotion.
I will praise you with all my heart, Lord my God;
I will proclaim your greatness forever.
How great is your constant love for me!
You have saved me from the depths of the grave.
God, arrogant men are coming against me;
a gang of cruel men is trying to kill me,
people who pay no attention to you.
Lord, you are a merciful and loving God,
slow to anger, always kind and faithful.
Turn to me and have mercy on me;
strengthen me and save me,
because I serve you, just as my mother did.
Show me proof of your goodness, Lord;
then those who hate me will be ashamed,
when they see that you have given me comfort and help.

items.label: Outside Easter
items.text: Blessed is the man who walks in justice and speaks what is true.

items.label: 17-23 December
items.text: About Sion, I will not be silent until her Holy One shines forth like light.

items.label: Eastertide
items.text: Our eyes will see the king in his splendour, alleluia.

strophes.t: You who are far off, hear what I have done;
you who are near recognize my strength.
Sinners in Zion are afraid;
trembling has seized the godless:
“Can any of us live with this devouring fire?
Can any of us live in endless burning?”
The man who acts honestly and speaks the truth,
who rejects dishonest profit,
who will not touch a bribe,
who will not hear of shedding blood,
who will not look at an evil plot:
this man will have a house on the heights;
mountain rocks will shelter and protect him;
he will have water and food in steady supply.

items.label: Outside Easter
items.text: Acclaim the King, the Lord.

items.label: 17-23 December
items.text: The Spirit of the Lord is upon me. He sent me to bring the Good News to the poor.

items.label: Eastertide
items.text: All men will see the salvation of our God, alleluia.

blocks.title: God the Ruler of the World

strophes.t: Sing a new song to the Lord;
he has done wonderful things!
By his own power and holy strength.
he has won the victory.
The Lord announced his victory;
he made his saving power known to the nations.
He kept his promise to the people of Israel,
with constant love and loyalty for them.
All people everywhere have seen the victory of our God!
Sing for joy to the Lord, all the earth;
praise him with songs and shouts of joy!
Sing praises to the Lord with harps;
play music on the harps!
With trumpets and horns,
shout for joy before the Lord, the king!
Roar, sea, and all creatures in you;
sing, earth, and all who live there!
Clap your hands, oceans;
hills, sing together with joy before the Lord,
because he comes to rule the earth!
He will rule all peoples of the world
with justice and fairness.

paras.t: Antiphons for Advent, Christmastide, Lent & Eastertide, see Pg 14

items.label: Through the Year
items.text: Any man who follows me will not be walking in the dark; he will have the light of life, says the Lord.

blocks.title: Light from the Law of the Lord

strophes.t: Your word is a lamp to guide me,
and a light for my path,
I will keep my solemn promise
to obey your righteous instructions.
My sufferings, Lord, are terrible indeed;
Keep me alive, as you have promised!
Accept my prayer of thanks, Lord,
and teach me your commands.
I am always ready to risk my life;
I have not forgotten your law.
Wicked men lay a trap for me,
but I have not disobeyed your commands.
Your commandments are my eternal possession;
they are the joy of my heart.
I have decided to obey your rules,
until the day I die.

items.label: Through the Year
items.text: I am wretched and poor; O God, help me.

strophes.t: Save me, God!
Lord, help me now!
May those who try to kill me
be defeated and confused!
May those who are happy because of my troubles
be turned back and disgraced!
May those who make fun of me
be dismayed by their defeat!
May all who come to you
be glad and joyful!
May all who love your salvation
always say, “How great God is!”
I am weak and helpless;
come quickly to me, God.
You are my helper and Saviour B
do not delay, Lord!

items.label: Through the Year
items.text: God will not judge by appearances, but he will rule with justice and fairness.

strophes.t: We praise you, God, we praise you!
We proclaim how great you are.
and tell the wonderful things you have done!
AI have set a time for judgment,” says God,
Aand I will judge with fairness.
Though the earth and all who live on it disappear,
I will keep its foundations firm.
I tell the proud not to brag,
and the wicked not to be arrogant;
I tell them to quit showing off
and to stop their bragging.”
Judgment does not come from the east or from the west,
from the north or from the south;
it is God who does the judging,
putting some down and lifting others up.
The Lord holds a cup in his hand,
full of fresh wine, very strong;
he pours it out, and all the wicked drink it;
they drink it down to the last drop.
But I will never stop speaking of the God of Jacob,
or singing praises to him.
He will break the power of the wicked,
but the power of the righteous will be increased.

items.label: Outside Easter
items.text: Those, who were sowing in tears, will sing when they reap.

items.label: 17-23 December
items.text: The Lord who is all-powerful will come from Sion to save his people.

items.label: Eastertide
items.text: Your sorrow will turn to joy, alleluia.

strophes.t: When the Lord brought us back to Zion,
it was like a dream!
How we laughed, how we sang for joy!
Then the other nations said about us,
“The Lord did great things for them.”
Indeed he did great things for us;
how happy we were!
Lord, take us back to our land,
just as your rain brings water back to dry riverbeds.
Let those who cried while they planted
gather the harvest with joy!
Those who cried as they went out carrying the seed
will come back singing for joy,
bringing in the harvest!

items.label: Outside Easter
items.text: The Lord will build a house for us; he will watch over our city.

items.label: 17-23 December
items.text: About Sion, I will not be silent until her Holy One shines forth like light.

items.label: Eastertide
items.text: Whether we live or whether we die, we belong to the Lord, alleluia.

strophes.t: If the Lord does not build the house,
the work of the builders is useless;
if the Lord does not protect the city,
it does no good for the sentries to stand guard.
It is useless to work so hard for a living,
getting up early and going to bed late,
because the Lord gives rest to those he loves.
Children are a gift from the Lord;
they are a real blessing.
The sons a man has when he is young
are like arrows in a soldier's hand.
Happy is the man who has many such arrows!
He will never be defeated
when he meets his enemies in the place of judgement.

items.label: Outside Easter
items.text: He is the first-born of all creation; he is supreme over all creatures.

items.label: 17-23 December
items.text: The Spirit of the Lord is upon me. He sent me to bring the Good News to the poor.

items.label: Eastertide
items.text: From him, through him and in him are all things that exist: to him be glory for ever, alleluia.

strophes.t: Give thanks, with joy, to the Father
who has made you fit to have your share
of what God has reserved for his people
in the kingdom of light.
For he rescued us from the power of darkness
and brought us safe into the kingdom of his dear Son,
by whom we are set free
and our sins are forgiven.
Christ is the visible liikeness
of the invisible God.
He is the first-born Son,
superior to all created things,
including spiritual powers,
lords, rulers, and authorities.
God created the whole universe
through him and for him.
He existed before all things,
and in union with Him
all things have their proper place.
He is the head of his body, the church;
he is the source of the body's life.
He is the first-born Son
who was raised from death,
In order that he alone
might have the first place in all things.
For it was by God's own decision
that the Son has in himself the fullness of perfection.
Through the Son, then, God decided
to bring the whole universe back to himself.
God made peace through his Son's death on the cross,
and so brought back to himself all things,
both on earth and in heaven.

items.label: Outside Easter
items.text: Glorious things are told of you, O city of God.

items.label: 17-23 December
items.text: I look to you, Lord, for help; come and save me, Lord, for I seek refuge in you.

items.label: Eastertide
items.text: We will dance and sing; you are the source of our life and our joy, city of God, alleluia.

strophes.t: God built his city on the sacred hills;
he loves the city of Jerusalem more than any other
place in Israel.
Listen, city of God,
to the wonderful things he says about you:
“When I list the nations that obey me,
I will include Egypt and Babylonia;
and I will say of Philistia, Tyre, and Ethiopia,
that they also belong to Jerusalem.”
Of Zion it will be said
that all nations belong there,
and the Most High will make her strong.
The Lord will write a list of the peoples,
and include them all as citizens of Jerusalem.
All who live there will sing and dance.

items.label: Outside Easter
items.text: The Lord is coming in power; the prize of his victory is with him.

items.label: 17-23 December
items.text: Lord, give those who wait for you their reward, and let your prophets be found worthy of belief.

items.label: Eastertide
items.text: He will tend his flock like a shepherd and carry them in his arms, alleluia.

strophes.t: Here comes the Lord our God in power
to rule all things by the strength of his arm.
Already he has won the prize,
and gained the reward.
He is like a shepherd tending his flock,
gathering lambs in his arms,
holding them against his breast,
and watching their mothers with care.
Who ever measured the sea in his palms,
and the extent of the sky by the width of his hand?
Who ever measured the earth's soil with a sack,
weighed the mountains on a balance and the hills on a scale?
Who ever found limits to the spirit of the Lord,
or stood by him to give him advice?
Whom did he ever consult
to teach him the right thing to do
and help him to understand?
Even the nations are like drops in a bucket
or like water sprinkled on a scale;
the coast cities weigh no more than powder.
Lebanon's forests are not enough for fuel,
nor its animals for burning in offering.
Before him the nations do not exist;
he counts them as empty and useless land.

items.label: Outside Easter
items.text: Exalt the Lord our God; bow down before his holy mountain.

items.label: 17-23 December
items.text: Turn to us, Lord, and make no delay in coming to your servants.

items.label: Eastertide
items.text: The Lord is great in Sion; he is supreme above all peoples, alleluia.

strophes.t: The Lord is king; the people tremble;
he sits on his throne on the cherubim; the earth shakes.
The Lord is mighty in Zion;
he rules over all the nations.
Everyone will praise his great and majestic name.
Holy is he!
Mighty king, you love what is right;
you have brought justice to Israel;
you have brought righteousness and fairness.
Praise the Lord our God;
worship before his throne!
Holy is he!
Moses and Aaron were his priests,
and Samuel was one who worshipped him;
they called to the Lord and he answered them.
He spoke to them from the column of cloud;
they obeyed the laws and commandments that he gave them.
Lord, our God, you answered your people;
you showed them that you are a God who forgives,
but you punished them for their sins.
Praise the Lord our God
and worship at his sacred mountain!
The Lord our God is holy!

paras.t: Antiphons for Advent, Christmastide, Lent & Eastertide, see Pg 14

items.label: Through the Year
items.text: Uphold me by your promise, Lord, and I shall live.

blocks.title: Safety in the Law of the Lord

strophes.t: I hate those who are not loyal to you,
but I love your law.
You are my defender and protector;
I hope in your promise.
Go away from me, you sinful people!
I will obey the commandments of my God.
Give me strength, as you promised, and I shall live;
don't let me be disappointed in my hope!
Hold me, and I will be safe,
and I will always pay attention to your commands.
You reject all who disobey your laws;
their deceitful schemes are useless.
You treat all the wicked like rubbish,
and so I love your instructions.
Because of you, I am afraid;
I am filled with fear because of your judgments.

items.label: Through the Year
items.text: Come to our help, O God our savior, and forgive us our sins.

strophes.t: God, the heathen have invaded your people's land!
They have profaned your holy temple
and left Jerusalem in ruins.
They left the bodies of your people for birds to eat,
the bodies of your servants for wild animals.
They shed your people's blood like water;
blood flowed like water all over Jerusalem,
and no one was left to bury the corpses.
The nations around us make fun of us;
they laugh at us and mock us.
How long will you be angry with us, Lord? Forever?
Will your anger continue to burn like fire?
Do not punish us for the sins of our ancestors,
but have mercy on us now,
because we have lost all hope.
Help us, God our Saviour,
for the sake of your own honour;
rescue us and forgive our sins,
so that people will praise you.
Why should the nations ask us,
“Where is your God?”
Let us see you punish the nations
for shedding the blood of your servants!
Listen to the groans of the prisoners,
and by your power free those who are condemned to die.
And we, your people, the sheep of your flock,
will thank you forever
and praise you for all time to come.

items.label: Through the Year
items.text: God of hosts, look down from heaven, and come to visit this vine of yours.

blocks.title: A Prayer far the Nation's Restoration

strophes.t: Listen to us, Shepherd of Israel;
hear us leader of your flock.
Seated on your throne on the Cherubim,
reveal your love for the tribes of Ephraim,
Benjamin, and Manasseh !
Show us your strength;
come and save us !
Bring us back, God !
Show us your love and we will be saved!
How much longer, Lord God Almighty,
will you be angry with your people's prayers?
You have given us tears to eat,
a large cup of tears to drink.
You let the neighbouring nations fight over our land,
and our enemies make fun of us,
Bring us back, Almighty God !
Show us your love, and we will be saved!
You brought a grapevine out of Egypt;
you drove other nations and planted it in their land.
You cleared a place for it to grow;
its roots went deep, and it spread out over the whole land.
It covered the hills with its shade,
the giant cedars with its branches.
It extended its branches to the Mediterranean Sea,
and as far as the Euphrates River.
Why did you break down the fences around it ?
Now anyone passing by can steal its grapes;
wild pigs trample it down,
and all the wild animals eat it.
Turn to us, Almighty God !
Look down from heaven at us;
come and save your grapevine!
Come and save this vine that you yourself planted,
this young vine you made grow so strong!
Our enemies have set it on fire and cut it down;
look at them in anger and destroy them !
Protect and preserve the people you have chosen,
the nation you made grow so strong!
We will never turn away from you again;
keep us alive, and we will praise you,
Bring us back, Lord God Almighty!
Show us your love, and we will be saved!

items.label: Outside Easter
items.text: Your faithful shall ring out their joy as they enter your dwelling place, Lord.

items.label: 17-23 December
items.text: I look to you, Lord, for help; come and save me, Lord, for I seek refuge in you.

items.label: Eastertide
items.text: The Lord God gave him the throne of David, his father, alleluia.

strophes.t: Lord, do not forget David
and all the work he did.
Remember, Lord, what he promised,
the vow he made to you, the Mighty God of Israel;
“I will not go home or go to bed;
I will not rest or sleep,
until I provide a place for the Lord,
a home for the Mighty God of Israel.”
We heard about the covenant box in Bethlehem,
and found it in the fields of Jaar.
We said, “Let us go to the Lord's house;
let us worship before his throne!”
Come to your resting place, Lord, with the covenant box,
the symbol of your power.
May the priests proclaim that you save your people;
may all your people shout for joy!
You made a promise to your servant David,
do not reject your chosen king, Lord!

items.label: Outside Easter
items.text: The Lord has chosen Sion as his dwelling place.

items.label: 17-23 December
items.text: Lord, give those who wait for you their reward, and let your prophets be found worthy of belief.

items.label: Eastertide
items.text: Jesus Christ is the only Ruler over all, the King of kings and Lord of lords, alleluia.

strophes.t: You made a solemn promise to David,
and you will not take it back;
“I will make one of your sons king,
and he will rule after you.
If your sons are true to my covenant,
and to the commands I give them,
their sons, also, will follow you as kings for all time.”
The Lord has chosen Zion;
he wants to make his home there:
“This is where I will live forever;
this is where I want to rule.
I will richly provide Zion with all she needs;
I will satisfy her poor with food.
I will have her priests proclaim that I save,
and her people will sing and shout for joy.
Here I will make one of David's descendants a great king;
here I will preserve the rule of my chosen king.
I will cover his enemies with shame,
but his kingdom will prosper and flourish.”

items.label: Outside Easter
items.text: The Lord has given him power and honour and empire and all peoples will serve him.

items.label: 17-23 December
items.text: Turn to us, Lord, and make no delay in coming to your servants.

items.label: Eastertide
items.text: Lord, who is your like, majestic in strength and holiness? Alleluia.

strophes.t: Lord God Almighty,
the one who is and who was!
we thank you that you have used your great power
and have begun to rule,
The heathen were filled with rage,
for it is the time for your wrath to come,
and for the dead to be judged;
the time to give the reward to your servants the prophets,
and to all your people, great and small,
to all who fear you.
Now God's salvation has come!
Now God has shown his power as King!
Now his Messiah has shown his authority!
For the accuser of our brothers, who stood before God
accusing them day and night,
has been thrown out of heaven.
Our brothers won the victory over him
by the blood of the Lamb,
and by the truth which they proclaimed;
for they were willing to give up their lives and die.
And so rejoice, you heavens,
and all you who live there!

items.label: Outside Easter
items.text: Against you alone have I sinned; Lord, have mercy on me.

items.label: 17-23 December
items.text: The one who is to rule will come from Sion: `The Lord, Immanuel' is his great name.

items.label: Eastertide
items.text: O Lord, wash me more and more from my guilt, alleluia.

strophes.t: Be merciful to me, God,
because of your constant love;
wipe away my sins,
because of your great mercy!
Wash away my evil,
and make me clean from my sin!
I recognise my faults;
I am always conscious of my sins.
I have sinned against you B only against you,
and done what you consider evil.
So you are right in judging me;
you are justified in condemning me.
I have been evil from the time I was born;
from the day of my birth I have been sinful.
A faithful heart is what you want;
fill my mind with your wisdom.
Remove my sin, and I will be clean;
wash me, and I will be whiter than snow.
Let me hear the sounds of joy and gladness;
and though you have crushed and broken me,
I will be happy once again.
Close your eyes to my sins,
and wipe out all my evil.
Create a pure heart in me, God,
and put a new and loyal spirit in me.
Do not banish me from your presence;
do not take your holy Spirit away from me.
Give me again the joy that comes from your salvation,
and make my spirit obedient.
Then I will teach sinners your commands,
and they will turn back to you.
Spare my life, God my Saviour,
and I will gladly proclaim your righteousness.
Help me to speak, Lord,
and I will praise you.
You do not want sacrifices,
or I would offer them;
you are not pleased with burnt offerings.
My sacrifice is a submissive spirit, God;
a submissive and obedient heart you will not reject.
God, be kind to Zion and help her;
rebuild the walls of Jerusalem.
Then you will be pleased with the proper sacrifices,
and with all burnt offerings;
and bulls will be sacrificed on your altar.

items.label: Outside Easter
items.text: We know our offences, Lord; we have sinned against you.

items.label: 17-23 December
items.text: Stand steadfast. You will see the helping power of the Lord.

items.label: Eastertide
items.text: Christ bore our sins in his own body on the cross, alleluia.

strophes.t: My eyes are streaming with tears,
day and night without rest,
for the young lady, who is my people,
has suffered a most serious wound.
If I go out to the farm,
I see men killed by the sword.
If I go into the city,
I see people sick with hunger.
Even prophets and priests
hunt for food in a foreign land.
Is it that you have rejected Judah,
and you hate the sight of Zion?
Why have you wounded us,
and left us unhealed?
We wait for peace,
but it does not come.
We wait to be healed,
but terror comes instead.
Lord, we confess our wickedness
and the guilt of our fathers;
yes, we have sinned against you.
For the honour of your name do not reject us,
or show contempt for Zion, the throne of your glory.
Remember your covenant with us,
and do not break it.

items.label: Outside Easter
items.text: The Lord is God; we are his people, the sheep of his flock.

items.label: 17-23 December
items.text: I look to the Lord; I will await the God who saves me.

items.label: Eastertide
items.text: Come before the Lord, singing for joy, alleluia.

strophes.t: Sing for joy to the Lord, all the world!
Worship the Lord gladly,
and come before him with joyful songs!
Never forget that the Lord is God!
He made us, and we belong to him!
we are his people, we are his flock.
Enter his temple with thanksgiving,
go into his sanctuary with praise
give thanks to him and praise his name!
The Lord is good,
his love lasts forever,
and his faithfulness for all time.

paras.t: Antiphons for Advent, Christmastide, Lent & Eastertide, see Pg 14

items.label: Through the Year
items.text: We saw him despised by men, a man of sorrows and acquainted with grief.

blocks.title: A Cry of Anguish and a Song of Praise

strophes.t: My God, my God, why have you abandoned me?
I have cried desperately for help.
but it still does not come!
During the day I call to you, my God,
but you do not answer;
I call at night,
but get no rest.
But you are enthroned as the Holy One,
the one whom Israel praises.
Our ancestors put their trust in you;
they trusted you, and you saved them.
They called to you and escaped from danger;
they trusted in you and were not disappointed.
But I am no longer a man; I am a worm,
despised and scorned by all!
All who see me make fun of me;
they stick out their tongues and shake their heads.
“You relied on the Lord,” they say. “Why doesn't he save you?
If the Lord likes you, why doesn't he help you?”
It was you who brought me safely through birth,
and when I was a baby you kept me safe.
I have relied on you ever since I was born;
since my birth you have been my God.
Do not stay away from me!
Trouble is near,
and there is no one to help.

items.label: Through the Year
items.text: They shared his clothes among them by casting lots.

blocks.title: A Cry of Anguish and a Song of Praise

strophes.t: Many enemies surround me like bulls;
they are all around me,
like fierce bulls from the land of Bashan.
They open their mouths like lions,
roaring and tearing at me.
My strength is gone,
gone like water spilled on the ground.
All my bones are out of joint;
my heart feels like melted wax inside me.
My throat is as dry as dust,
and my tongue sticks to the roof of my mouth.
You have left me for dead in the dust.
A gang of evil men is around me;
like a pack of dogs, they close in on me;
they tear my hands and feet.
All my bones can be seen.
My enemies look at me and stare.
They divide my clothes among themselves
and gamble for my robe.
Don’t stay away from me, Lord!
Hurry and help me, my Saviour!
Save me from the sword;
save my life from those dogs.
Rescue me from those lions;
I am helpless before those wild bulls.
I will tell my people what you have done;
I will praise you in their meeting.

items.label: Through the Year
items.text: All families of the nations will worship before the Lord.

blocks.title: A Cry of Anguish and a Song of Praise

strophes.t: “Praise him, you servants of the Lord!
Honour him, you descendants of Jacob;
worship him, you people of Israel!
He does not neglect the poor or ignore their suffering;
he does not keep away from them,
but answers when they call for help.”
In the full assembly I will praise you for what you have done;
in the presence of all who obey you
I will offer the sacrifices I promised.
The poor will eat as much as they want;
those who come to the Lord will praise him.
May they prosper forever!
All nations will remember the Lord;
from every part of the world they will turn to him;
all races will worship him.
The Lord is king,
and he rules over the nations.
All proud men will bow down to him;
all mortal men will bow down before him,
all those who are bound to die.
Future generations will serve him,
men will speak of the Lord to the coming generation.
People not yet born will be told:
“The Lord saved his people!”

items.label: Outside Easter
items.text: The Lord is great; our God is high above all gods.

items.label: 17-23 December
items.text: The one who is to rule will come from Sion: `The Lord, Immanuel' is his great name.

items.label: Eastertide
items.text: I, the Lord, am your Saviour, I am your Redeemer, alleluia.

strophes.t: Praise the Lord!
Praise his name, you servants of the Lord,
who stand in the Lord's house,
in the sanctuary of our God.
Praise the Lord, because he is good;
sing praises to his name, because he is kind.
He chose Jacob for himself,
the people of Israel for his own.
I know that our Lord is great;
he is greater than all the gods.
He does whatever he wishes
in heaven and on earth,
in the seas and in the depths below.
He brings storm clouds from the ends of the earth;
he makes lightning for the storms,
and brings out the wind from his store-room.
In Egypt he killed all the firstborn
of both men and animals.
There he performed miracles and wonders
to punish Pharaoh and all his officials.
He destroyed many nations,
and killed powerful kings:
Sihon, king of the Amorites,
Og, king of Bashan,
and all the kings in Canaan.
He gave their land to his people;
he gave it to Israel.

items.label: Outside Easter
items.text: Sons of Israel, bless the Lord! Sing a psalm to his name, for he is loving.

items.label: 17-23 December
items.text: Stand steadfast. You will see the helping power of the Lord.

items.label: Eastertide
items.text: Blessed is the kingdom of our father David which has come among us, alleluia.

strophes.t: Lord, men will always know that you are God;
all generations will remember you.
The Lord will take pity on his people;
he will set his servants free.
The idols of the nations are made of silver and gold;
they are formed by human hands.
They have mouths, but cannot speak,
and eyes, but cannot see.
They have ears, but cannot hear;
there is no breath in their mouths.
May those who made them and all who trust in them
become like the idols they have made!
Praise the Lord, people of Israel;
praise him, you priests of God!
Praise the Lord, you Levites;
Praise him, all you that fear him !
Praise the Lord in Zion,
in Jerusalem, his home.
Praise the Lord!

items.label: Outside Easter
items.text: All peoples will come and adore you, Lord.

items.label: 17-23 December
items.text: I look to the Lord; I will await the God who saves me.

items.label: Eastertide
items.text: Let us sing to the Lord; great is his triumph, alleluia.

strophes.t: Lord, God Almighty,
how great and wonderful are your deeds!
King of all nations,
how right and true are your ways!
Who will not fear you, Lord?
who will refuse to declare your greatness?
For you alone are holy.
All the nations will come and worship before you,
for your righteous deeds are seen by all.

items.label: Outside Easter
items.text: You, O Lord, are close: your ways are truth.

items.label: 17-23 December
items.text: God will come from Lebanon and his splendor is like the light.

items.label: Eastertide
items.text: The words I have spoken to you are spirit and they are life, alleluia.

strophes.t: With all my heart, I call to you;
answer me, Lord, and I will obey your commands!
I call to you;
save me, and I will follow your rules!
Before sunrise I call to you for help;
I place my hope in your promise.
All night long I lie awake,
to meditate on your instructions.
Hear me, Lord, according to your constant love;
preserve my life, according to your goodness!
My cruel persecutors are coming closer,
people who never keep your law.
But you are near to me, Lord,
and all your promises are true.
Long ago I learned about your instructions;
you made them to last forever.

items.label: Outside Easter
items.text: Lord, let your wisdom be with me to help me and to work with me.

items.label: 17-23 December
items.text: Send the Holy One, like the dew, you heavens, and let the clouds rain down. Let the earth open for the Saviour to spring forth.

items.label: Eastertide
items.text: Lord, you have set up your temple and altar on your holy mountain, alleluia.

strophes.t: God of my fathers, Lord of mercy,
who nave made all things by your word,
and in your wisdom have established man
to be master of your whole creation,
to govern the world in holiness and justice,
and to exercise authority in honesty of soul:
give me Wisdom, the attendant at your throne,
and do not reject me from among your children.
For I am your servant, just as my mother was,
a man weak and short-lived,
with small understanding of justice and the laws.
In fact, if a man is ever so perfect,
yet lacks the Wisdom that comes from you,
he counts for nothing at all.
With you is Wisdom, who knows your works
who was present when you made the world,
who understands what is pleasing to you
and what agrees with your commands.
Send her forth from your holy sky,
despatch her from your throne of glory,
that she may be with me and work with me,
and teach me what is pleasing to you.
For she knows and understands all things,
and will guide me wisely in my affairs
and keep me safe in her glory.

items.label: Outside Easter
items.text: The truth of the Lord will stand firm for ever.

items.label: 17-23 December
items.text: Israel, be ready to meet the Lord, for he is coming.

items.label: Eastertide
items.text: I am the Way, the Truth and the Life, alleluia.

strophes.t: Praise the Lord, all nations!
Praise him, all peoples!
His constant love for us is strong,
and his faithfulness is eternal.
Praise the Lord!

paras.t: Antiphons for Advent, Christmastide, Lent & Eastertide, see Pg 14

items.label: Through the Year
items.text: Lord, vouch for the welfare of your servant.

blocks.title: Obedience to the Law of the Lord

strophes.t: I have done what is right and good;
don't abandon me to my enemies!
Promise that you will help your servant,
don't let proud men trouble me!
My eyes are tired from watching for your salvation,
for the deliverance you promised.
Treat me according to your constant love,
and teach me your commands.
I am your servant, so give me understanding
that I may know your teachings.
Lord, it is time for you to act,
because people are disobeying your law!
I love your commands more than gold,
more than the finest gold.
And so I follow all your instructions;
I hate all wrong ways.

items.label: Through the Year
items.text: Look to the Lord and be radiant.

strophes.t: I will always thank the Lord;
I will never stop praising him.
I will praise him for what he has done;
may all who are oppressed listen and be glad;
Proclaim with me the Lord's greatness;
let us praise his name together!
I prayed to the Lord and he answered me;
he freed me from all my fears.
The oppressed look to him and are glad;
they will never be disappointed
The helpless call to him, and he answers;
he saves them from all their troubles.
His angel guards those who fear the Lord
and rescues them from danger.
Find out for yourself how good the Lord is!
Happy is the man who finds safety with him!
Fear the Lord, all his people;
those who fear him have all they need.
Even lions lack food and go hungry,
but those who obey the Lord lack nothing good.

items.label: Through the Year
items.text: The Lord is close to the broken-hearted.

strophes.t: Come, my young friends, and listen to me,
and I will teach you to fear the Lord.
Would you like to enjoy life?
Do you want long life and happiness?
Then keep from speaking evil
and from telling lies.
Turn away from evil and do good;
desire peace and do your best to have it.
The Lord watches over the righteous
and listens to their cries;
but he opposes those who do evil,
so that even their own people forget them.
Righteous men call to the Lord and he listens;
he rescues them from all their troubles.
The lord is near to those who are discouraged;
he saves those who have lost all hope.
The good man suffers many troubles,
but the Lord saves him from them all;
the Lord preserves him completely;
not one of his bones is broken.
Evil will kill the wicked;
those who hate the righteous will be punished.
The Lord will save his servants;
those who go to him for protection will be spared

items.label: Advent
items.text: See, the One desired by all the peoples will come, and the house of the Lord will be filled with glory, alleluia.

items.label: Lent
items.text: Let us enter God's house with rejoicing.

items.label: Eastertide
items.text: May the peace of Christ reign in your hearts, alleluia.

items.label: Through the Year
items.text: Pray for the peace of Jerusalem.

strophes.t: I was glad when they said to me,
“Let us go to the Lord's house!”
And now we are here,
standing inside the gates of Jerusalem!
Jerusalem is a city restored
in beautiful order and harmony!
This is where the tribes come,
the tribes of Israel,
to give thanks to the Lord,
as he commanded them.
This is where the law courts are,
where the king judges his people.
Pray for the peace of Jerusalem!
“May those who love you prosper!
May there be peace inside your walls,
and safety in your palaces.”
For the sake of my friends and companions,
I say to Jerusalem, “Peace be with you!”
For the sake of the house of the Lord, our God,
I pray for your prosperity.

items.label: Advent
items.text: Come, Lord, do not delay; release your people Israel from their bonds.

items.label: Lent
items.text: Sleepers, awake; rise from the dead; and Christ will give you light.

items.label: Eastertide
items.text: In your blood, you redeemed us for God, alleluia.

items.label: Through the Year
items.text: From the morning watch even until night, my soul is longing for the Lord.

strophes.t: In my despair I call to you, Lord,
Hear my cry, Lord,
listen to my call for help!
If you kept a record of our sins,
who could escape being condemned?
But you forgive us,
so that we should fear you.
I wait eagerly for the Lord's help,
and in his word I trust.
I wait for the Lord,
more eagerly than watchmen wait for the dawn,
than watchmen wait for the dawn.
Israel, trust in the Lord,
because his love is constant,
and he is always willing to save.
He will save his people Israel
from all their sins.

items.label: Advent
items.text: Behold, now the appointed time has come for God to send his Son into the world.

items.label: Lent
items.text: God loved us so much that he was generous with his mercy: when we were dead through our sins, he brought us to life in Christ.

items.label: Eastertide
items.text: Was it not necessary that Christ should suffer thus and so enter into his glory? Alleluia.

items.label: Through the Year
items.text: Let every creature, in heaven and on earth, bend the knee at the name of Jesus.

strophes.t: Christ Jesus always had the very nature of God,
but he did not think that by force
he should try to be treated equal with God.
Instead, of his own free will he gave it all up,
and took the nature of a servant.
He became like man,
he appeared in human likeness.
He was humble
and walked the path of obedience to death,
his death on the cross.
For this reason God raised him to the highest place above,
and gave him the name
that is greater than any other name,
So that, in honour of the name of Jesus,
all beings in heaven, and on the earth, and in the
world below
will fall on their knees,
and all will openly proclaim
that Jesus Christ is the Lord,
to the glory of God the Father.

items.label: Advent
items.text: Sound the trumpet in Sion for the Lord is near: see, he will come to save us, alleluia.

items.label: 24 December
items.text: You, Bethlehem, will not be least among the towns of Judah: for the leader who will rule my people Israel will come from you.

items.label: Lent
items.text: You are my God, I thank you. My God, I praise you.

items.label: Eastertide
items.text: I shall not die, I shall live and recount the deeds of the Lord, alleluia.

items.label: Through the Year
items.text: Give thanks to the Lord, for his great love is without end, alleluia.

blocks.title: A Prayer of Thanks for Victory

strophes.t: Give thanks to the Lord because he is good
and his love is eternal
Let the people of Israel say
“His love is eternal.”
Let the priests of God say,
“His love is eternal.”
Let all who fear him say,
“His love is eternal.”
In my distress I called to the Lord;
He answered me, and set me free.
The Lord is with me, I will not be afraid;
what can men do to me?
It is the Lord who helps me,
and I will see my enemies defeated.
It is better to trust in the Lord,
than to depend on men.
It is better to trust in the Lord,
than to depend on human leaders.
Many enemies were around me;
but I destroyed them by the power of the Lord !
They were around me on every side;
but I destroyed them by the power of the Lord !
They swarmed around me like bees,
but they burned out as quickly as a brush fire;
by the power of the Lord I destroyed them .
I was fiercely attacked and was being defeated,
but the Lord helped me.
The Lord makes me powerful and strong;
he is my Saviour?
Listen to the glad shouts of victory in the tents of God's people;
“The Lord’s mighty power has done it!
His power has brought us victory,
his mighty power in battle!”
I will not die, but I will live,
and tell what the Lord has done.
He has punished me severely,
but he has not let me die.
Open the gates of the temple for me;
I will go in and praise the Lord!
This is the gate of the Lord;
only the righteous can come in!
I praise, you Lord, because you heard me,
because you have given me victory!
The stone which the builders rejected as worthless,
turned out to be the most important of all.
This was done by the Lord;
what a wonderful sight it is!
What a wonderful day the Lord has given us;
let us be happy, let us celebrate!
Save us, Lord, save us!
Give us success, Lord!
God bless him who comes in the name of the Lord !
From the temple of the Lord we bless you!
The Lord is God; he has been good to us.
With branches in your hands start the festival
and march around the altar.
You are my God and I give you thanks;
I will proclaim your greatness.
Give thanks to the Lord, because he is good,
and his love is eternal.

items.label: Advent
items.text: The Lord comes! Go to meet him and say: Great is his reign, and his kingdom will have no end. He is God, the Strong One, the Ruler of the world, the Prince of peace, alleluia.

items.label: 24 December
items.text: Lift up your heads for your redemption is at hand.

items.label: Lent
items.text: Lord, you can deliver us from the hand of the one who is stronger than we are; save us, Lord, our God.

items.label: Eastertide
items.text: Blessed be your glorious and holy name, alleluia.

items.label: Through the Year
items.text: Alleluia, all works of the Lord bless the Lord, alleluia.

strophes.t: Thanks be to you, Lord God of our fathers.
To you glory and praise forever.
Thanks for your holy and glorious name.
To you glory and praise forever.
Thanks be to you in the temple of your glory.
To you glory and praise forever.
Thanks be to you on the throne of your kingdom,
To you glory and praise forever.
Thanks be to you, who come on the clouds.
To you glory and praise forever.
Thanks be to you, who look down at the depths.
To you glory and praise forever.
Thanks be to you in the dome of the sky.
To you glory and praise forever.
All you, works of the Lord, bless the Lord
To him glory and praise forever.

items.label: Advent
items.text: Your all-powerful Word, Lord, will come from the royal throne, alleluia.

items.label: 24 December
items.text: Tomorrow, your salvation will be with you, says the Lord, God almighty.

items.label: Lent
items.text: Praise God in his wonderful works.

items.label: Eastertide
items.text: Tell the greatness of our God. The works of God are perfect; and all his ways are right, alleluia.

items.label: Through the Year
items.text: Let everything that breathes give praise to the Lord, alleluia.

strophes.t: Praise the Lord!
Praise God in his temple!
Praise his strength in heaven!
Praise him for the mighty things he has done!
Praise his supreme greatness!
Praise him with trumpets!
Praise him with harps and lyres!
Praise him with drums and dancing!
Praise him with harps and flutes!
Praise him with cymbals!
Praise him with loud cymbals!
Praise the Lord, all living creatures!
Praise the Lord!

paras.t: Antiphons for Advent, Christmastide, Lent & Eastertide, see Pg 14

items.label: Through the Year
items.text: Whoever eats this bread will live for ever, alleluia.

strophes.t: The Lord is my shepherd;
I have everything I need.
He lets me rest in fields of green grass
and leads me to quiet pools of fresh water.
He gives me new strength.
He guides me in the right way,
as he has promised.
Even if that way goes through deepest darkness,
I will not be afraid, Lord,
because you are with me!
Your shepherd's rod and staff keep me safe.
You prepare a banquet for me,
where all my enemies can see me;
You welcome me by pouring ointment on my head
and filling my cup to the brim.
Certainly your goodness and love will be with me
as long as I live;
and your house will be my home forever.

items.label: Through the Year
items.text: The Lord will come in glory and he will do wonderful things for his saints, alleluia.

strophes.t: God is well known in Judah,
and famous in Israel.
He has his home in Jerusalem
he lives on Mount Zion.
There he broke the arrows of the enemies,
their shields and swords, yes, all their weapons.
How glorious you are, God!
How majestic, as you return from the mountains
where you defeated your foes!
Their brave soldiers have been stripped of their loot,
and are now sleeping the sleep of death;
there is no one left to use their weapons.
When you threatened them, God of Jacob,
the horses and their riders fell dead.

items.label: Through the Year
items.text: Offer prayers and gifts to the Lord your God, alleluia.

strophes.t: But you - how men fear you!
Who can stand in your presence
when you are angry?
You made your judgement known from heaven;
the earth was afraid and lay still,
when you rose up to pronounce judgement,
to save all the oppressed on earth.
Men's anger only result in more praise for you;
those who survive the wars will keep your festivals.
Give the Lord your God what you promised him;
all you nearby nations bring gifts to him.
God makes men fear him;
he humiliates proud princes,
and terrorizes great kings.

items.label: Advent
items.text: See, how splendid is he who comes to save the peoples.

items.label: Lent
items.text: God has appointed him to judge everyone, living and dead.

items.label: Eastertide
items.text: You must look for the things of heaven, where Christ is, sitting at God's right hand, alleluia.

items.label: Through the Year
items.text: In holy splendor, I begot you before the dawn, alleluia.

blocks.title: The Lord and His Chosen King

strophes.t: The Lord said to my Lord, the king,
“Sit here at my right side,
until I put your enemies under your feet.”
From Zion the Lord will extend your royal power.
“Rule over your enemies,” he says.
The day you fight your enemies
your people will volunteer.
Like the dew early in the morning,
your young men will come to you on the sacred hills.
The Lord made a solemn promise and will not take it back:
“You will be a priest forever,
in the priestly order of Melchizedek.”
The Lord is at your right side;
he will defeat kings on the day he becomes angry.
The king will drink from the stream by the road,
and strengthened, he will stand victorious.

items.label: Advent
items.text: The rugged places shall be made smooth and the mountain-ranges shall become plain. Come, Lord, and do not delay, alleluia.

items.label: Lent
items.text: Happy is the man to whom the Lord shows mercy; he will never waver.

items.label: Eastertide
items.text: He has risen as a light in the darkness, for the upright of heart, alleluia.

items.label: Through the Year
items.text: Blessed are those who hunger and thirst for justice, for they shall have their fill.

blocks.title: The Happiness of a Good Person

strophes.t: Praise the Lord!
Happy is the man who fears the Lord,
who takes pleasure in obeying his commands.
His children will be mighty in the land;
the good man's descendants will be blessed.
His family will be wealthy and rich,
and he will be prosperous forever.
Light shines in the darkness for good men,
for those who are kind, merciful, and just.
Happy is the man who is generous in his loans,
who runs his business honestly.
A good man will never fail;
he will never be forgotten.
He is not afraid of receiving bad news;
his faith is strong, and he trusts in the Lord.
He is not worried or afraid;
he is certain he will see his enemies defeated.
He gives generously to the needy,
and his kindness is eternal;
he will be powerful and respected.
The wicked see this and are upset;
they glare in anger and disappear;
their hopes are gone forever.

items.label: Advent
items.text: Great will be his reign and peace will be everlasting, alleluia.

items.label: Eastertide
items.text: Alleluia, victory and glory and power to our God, alleluia.

items.label: Through the Year
items.text: Praise God, all you his servants, both great and small, alleluia.

strophes.t: Halleluia! Salvation, glory, and power belong to our God!
Halleluia!
True and righteous are his judgements! Halleluia, halleuia!
Halleluia ! Praise our God, all his servants, Halleluia!
and all men, both great and small, who fear him!
Halleluia, halleluia!
Halleluia! For the Lord, our Almighty God, is King! Halleluia!
Let us rejoice and be glad; let us praise his greatness!
Halleluia, halleluia!
Halleluia! For the time has come for the wedding of the Lamb.
Halleluia !
and his bride has prepared herself for it. Halleluia, halleluia!
Halleluia ! She has been permitted to dress herself. Halleluia!
with clean shining linen. Halleluia, halleluia!

items.label: Outside Easter
items.text: In the morning, Lord, you fill us with your love.

items.label: 17-23 December
items.text: Behold, the Lord, the ruler of the kings of the earth, will come. Happy are those who are ready to meet him.

items.label: 24 December
items.text: You, Bethlehem, will not be least among the towns of Judah: for the leader who will rule my people Israel will come from you.

items.label: Eastertide
items.text: Let the splendour of the Lord, our God, be upon us, alleluia.

strophes.t: Lord, you have always been our home.
Before the hills were created,
before you brought the world into being.
you are eternally God, without beginning or end.
You tell men to return to what they were;
you change them back to soil.
A thousand years to you are like one day;
they are like yesterday, already gone,
like a short hour in the night.
You carry men away like a flood;
they last no longer than a dream.
They are like weeds that sprout in the morning,
that grow and burst into bloom,
then dry up and die in the evening.
We are destroyed by your anger;
we are terrified by your fury.
You place our sins before you,
our secret sins where you can see them.
Our lifetime is cut short by your anger;
our life comes to an end like a whisper.
Seventy years is all we have B
eighty years, if we are strong;
yet all they bring us is worry and trouble;
life is soon over, and we are gone.
Who really knows the full power of your anger?
Who knows what fear your fury can bring?
Teach us how short our life is,
so that we may become wise.
How long, Lord; before you relent?
Have pity on your servants!
Fill us each morning with your constant love,
that we may sing and be glad all our life.
Give us now as much happiness as you gave us sadness,
during all these years when we had troubles.
Let us, your servants, see your mighty acts;
let our descendants see your glorious might.
Lord our God, may your blessings be with us,
and give us success in all we do!
Yes, give us success in all we do!

items.label: Outside Easter
items.text: Let the praise of the Lord resound from the ends of the earth.

items.label: 17-23 December
items.text: Sing to the Lord a new song, his praise to the end of the earth.

items.label: 24 December
items.text: Lift up your heads for your redemption is at hand.

items.label: Eastertide
items.text: I will turn darkness into light before them, alleluia.

strophes.t: Sing a new song to the Lord!
Praise him everywhere on earth.
Praise him, sailors, with all creatures in the sea!
Praise him, you who live in the cities by the sea.
Sing loudly, you towns of the desert,
and you, Kedar people, in your camps!
Cry aloud, you who live in Sela,
shout from your mountain tops!
Proclaim the glory of the Lord,
praise Him with the people of the coasts!
The Lord advances like a hero,
like a warrior he stirs up his fury.
He shouts his battle cry,
and smashes his enemies.
“I, the Lord, have been quiet too long,
and have kept silent, keeping myself in check.
But now I am like a woman in labour,
crying and gasping and panting.
